label: Leaf temperature
description: median of the coolest half of the pixels (authors' rule), median over frames

label: Leaf temperature, coolest 10 %
description: 10th percentile of the image; a stricter leaf estimate

label: Background temperature
description: 75th percentile of the image: mostly pots and soil, which also warm as they dry

label: Leaf temperature at 160 x 120
description: same rule on the image averaged to 160 x 120 pixels (cheaper camera)

label: Leaf temperature at 80 x 60
description: same rule on the image averaged to 80 x 60 pixels (cheaper camera)

label: Leaf minus air temperature
description: leaf temperature minus the W1-end air sensor at the capture time

label: Leaf minus control-bed leaf
description: leaf temperature minus the median leaf temperature of the control-bed plants in the same run (other controls for a control plant); cancels weather
